battle.name: 安哥拉獨立戰爭
battle.theater: 安哥拉北部盧達與東部莫希科山區
battle.brief: 一九六一年二月四日，安哥拉人民解放運動在羅安達與本格拉起事，把地方衝突推成十四年的反殖民戰爭，直至一九七四年。卡面這支蘇聯製AK-47自動步槍，是MPLA、FNLA與UNITA游擊隊常用的步槍：便宜、耐操、雨林碎石路上不易卡殼，讓缺乏重火力的游擊小隊得以在葡軍直升機與砲火間周旋。

kit.name: AK-47自動步槍
kit.history: AK-47是蘇聯於1947年研製的5.45×39mm口徑自動步槍，以可靠性聞名，成為華約及多國游擊隊的主要步兵武器。

countries: 這場戰爭是葡萄牙殖民當局與安哥拉民族主義運動在安哥拉海外省境內打響的反殖民戰爭，交戰主體一邊是葡萄牙王國的殖民軍與保安部隊，另一邊是MPLA、FNLA與UNITA等游擊組織。葡萄牙方面，安哥拉自一九五一年起被劃入海外省體制，由總督兼武總司令統一管治，一九六一年之後按北部、中部、南部、東部四個軍事區劃分，一九六七年再改稱作戰區；陸軍以獵兵連為基本戰術單位，早期編制是三個步槍排加一個支援排，後改為四個戰鬥組，另配火砲、裝甲偵察、工兵、通信、憲兵與勤務分隊，並有第二十一空降營作機動打擊。保安系統由公共治安警察與PIDE國際及國家防務警察負責，PIDE於一九六九年改組為國家警務署DGS。空軍隸屬第二空區，設羅安達九號基地，另有涅加熱與亨里克·德卡瓦柳兩處分區機場。中後期有南非空軍與地面部隊在南部協同作戰，一九七五年十月二十三日南非自納米比亞越境投入一千五百至兩千人。安哥拉方面，一九五四年七月七日霍爾登·羅伯托在北部成立安哥拉北部人民聯盟，一九五六年Viriato da Cruz與Agostinho Neto等人合併兩個組織成立MPLA，一九六六年Jonas Savimbi另組UNITA，另有FLEC主張卡賓達自治、一九七三年Daniel Chipenda拉出東方起義等分裂派別。參與者結構上，殖民軍中黑人比例由開戰時的百分之十八升至最多百分之四十一，另有以流亡卡坦加憲兵為骨幹的Fieis三營部隊。
countriesEn: This was an anti-colonial war fought inside the Portuguese overseas province of Angola between the colonial authorities of Portugal and the Angolan nationalist guerrillas. On one side stood the armed forces and the security organs of the Portuguese Republic, which had folded Angola into the overseas province system from 1951, governed by a Governor-General who was also commander-in-chief; from 1961 the territory was divided into a Northern, a Central, a Southern and an Eastern military zone, renamed military zones in 1967. The tactical unit of the army was the caçadores company, first organised as three rifle platoons with one support platoon and later reorganised into four identical combat groups, backed by artillery, armoured reconnaissance, engineers, signals, military police and service units, with the 21st Paratrooper Battalion serving as a mobile intervention force. Internal security lay with the Public Security Police and with the PIDE, the International and State Defense Police, which was reorganised as the DGS in 1969. The air force belonged to the Second Air Region, with the main base at Luanda and sector aerodromes at Negage and at Henrique de Carvalho. From the late 1960s the Portuguese relied on South African air support in the south, and on 23 October 1975 South African troops crossed from Namibia into southern Angola in a force of between 1,500 and 2,000 men. On the Angolan side, the Union of the Peoples of Northern Angola was founded in the north on 7 July 1954 by Holden Roberto, the MPLA was created in 1956 by the merger of two organisations around Viriato da Cruz and Agostinho Neto, and UNITA was founded in 1966 by Jonas Savimbi; alongside them stood FLEC, which claimed autonomy for the Cabinda enclave, and the Eastern Revolt of Daniel Chipenda, a splinter that left the MPLA in 1973. In the composition of the colonial army the share of black soldiers rose from eighteen per cent at the outbreak of the war to at most forty-one per cent, and a three-battalion corps of Fieis, made up largely of exiled Katangese gendarmes, was also raised.
people: 關鍵人物分屬交戰兩面。MPLA一方，總書記Viriato da Cruz出身知識分子，卻是組織內最出色的游擊戰指揮者，一九六一年在北部盧達地區率小分隊作戰，重傷之後於一九六二年二月在撤退戰中陣亡；同樣被捕的Mário Pinto de Andrade曾在聖多美島Baixa de Casanje監獄越獄，最終與da Cruz同日戰死。Agostinho Neto自一九五六年起任MPLA主席，一九六九年成為唯一領袖，在東部莫希科與夸恩多·庫班戈地區重建游擊根據地，一九七五年十一月十一日在羅安達宣布獨立。FNLA一方，總書記霍爾登·羅伯托一九五四年組建北部人民聯盟，其武裝安哥拉民族解放軍在剛果與沙伊境內受訓，資金來自美國，武器多由東歐供應，他與蒙博托的關係是安哥拉北部戰線得以長期維持的關鍵。UNITA的Jonas Savimbi一九六六年脫離FNLA另立旗號，在南部與東部高地以中國來源的武器活動，一九七〇年代中期起成為西方與南非援助的主要對象；Daniel Chipenda於一九七三年率眾脫離MPLA另組東方起義。葡方一線，總理薩拉查在電視講詞中以「迅速而有力地到安哥拉去」定下基調，一九六一年四月起大批本土主力開赴安哥拉；總督先後由Silva Tavares、Deslandes、Kaúlza de Arriaga與António de Spínola擔任；陸軍方面Silva Freire任第三軍事區司令時於一九六四年十一月十日空中巡察墜機身亡，接任者是Fino。反游擊指揮風格分歧明顯，Cardos Coelho主張放手使用非洲士兵，Costa Gomes被視為最成功的反游擊指揮官，Kaúlza則最為保守。
peopleEn: The decisive figures split between the two sides of the conflict. In the MPLA, Viriato da Cruz, secretary-general, was an intellectual by training but the most gifted field commander in the organisation; he fought small detachments in the Lunda area of the north in 1961, was badly wounded, and was killed in a rearguard action in February 1962. Mário Pinto de Andrade, arrested with him, had escaped from the Baixa de Casanje prison in São Tomé in January 1961 and died in the same fighting. Agostinho Neto, president of the MPLA from its foundation in 1956, became the unchallenged leader from 1969, rebuilt the guerrilla base areas in Moxico and Cuando Cubango in the east, and proclaimed independence in Luanda on 11 November 1975. On the FNLA side the party secretary, Holden Roberto, had founded the northern movement in 1954; its armed wing, the National Liberation Army of Angola, was trained in the Congo and in Zaire, financed from the United States and supplied with weapons largely from the Eastern bloc, and his close tie to Mobutu was what allowed the northern front to be sustained for years. Jonas Savimbi, who left the FNLA and founded UNITA in 1966, operated in the south and in the eastern highlands on weapons of Chinese origin and became, from the mid-1970s, the principal recipient of Western and South African support; in 1973 Daniel Chipenda led a walkout from the MPLA and founded the Eastern Revolt. On the Portuguese side the tone was set by Prime Minister Salazar in a television address, to Angola, rapidly and in force, and from April 1961 large contingents of the metropole's troops were shipped out to the colony. The Governor-Generals of the province passed in turn through the hands of Silva Tavares, Deslandes, Kaúlza de Arriaga and António de Spínola. In the army, Silva Freire, commander of the Third Military Region, was killed in an air crash while on a reconnaissance flight on 10 November 1964 and was succeeded by Fino. The styles of the counter-insurgency commanders differed sharply, with Cardos Coelho advocating the employment of African soldiers, Costa Gomes generally regarded as the most successful of the counter-insurgency commanders, and Kaúlza the most conservative of the three.
kits: 卡面這支AK-47是蘇聯一九四七年定型的自動步槍，口徑七點六二乘三十九毫米，配三十發弧形彈匣與木質槍托，全長約八百八十毫米，空槍重約四點三公斤，槍口初速每秒約七百一十五米，理論射速每分鐘約六百發，有效射程三百至四百米。它的價值不在精準而在可靠：叢林裡的灰塵、泥水與粗劣維修都難以令它卡殼，五發匣、十發匣與去掉木托的改法在游擊隊手中很常見，後坐力大、槍口焰明、重量偏沉則是它的短處。彈藥與整槍的來源是這場戰爭的關鍵變數。FNLA與UPA部隊的步槍多在剛果與沙伊的市場上取得，部分由東歐國家供應，資金則來自美國；MPLA自一九七〇年得到中國援助，一九六〇年代末起蘇聯經坦尚尼亞與贊比亞大量供應武器，一九六九年雙方更就獨立後的軍事基地達成協議，一九七四年因東方起義蘇聯一度完全中斷援助，到十一月才恢復。UNITA在一九七〇年代中期起的中國供應裡同樣有中國製的AK衍生型。葡軍的輕武器是西歐制式：G3步槍與G3E班機槍、FN MAG中型機槍、二吋與八一毫米迫擊砲、一〇五毫米榴彈砲，裝備有M41坦克、Panhard輕型裝甲車與M113步兵車，後勤靠Land Rover與三噸卡車，海運則由運輸船NIASSA與BENGUELA號承擔。空軍初期的架數是二十五架F-84G噴氣戰鬥轟炸機、六架PV-2 Harpoon轟炸機、六架Nord Noratlas運輸機、六架Alouette II直升機、八架T-6輕型攻擊機與八架Auster觀察機；到一九七〇年代初改為四架F-84G、六架PV-2、十三架Noratlas、C-47與C-57運輸機、三十架Alouette III與Puma直升機、十八架T-6與二十六架Dornier Do 27觀察機，但面對安哥拉的廣闊地面，機數始終不足。
kitsEn: The AK-47 on the card was the automatic rifle type standardised by the Soviet Union in 1947. It fires the 7.62x39mm cartridge, is fed from a curved thirty-round magazine and carries a wooden stock; it is about eight hundred and eighty millimetres long, weighs about four point three kilograms empty, has a muzzle velocity of roughly seven hundred and fifteen metres per second, a theoretical rate of fire of about six hundred rounds a minute and an effective range of three to four hundred metres. Its value lies not in accuracy but in reliability: dust, mud and rough field repair in the bush rarely stop it, and short five-round or ten-round magazines and stockless conversions were common in guerrilla hands, while heavy recoil, a bright muzzle flash and its weight remained its weaknesses. Where the arms came from was the decisive variable of this war. FNLA and UPA rifles were largely bought in the markets of the Congo and Zaire, some supplied by Eastern bloc states, with the money coming from the United States. The MPLA began to receive Chinese aid from 1970, and from the late 1960s the Soviet Union shipped large quantities of arms to it through Tanzania and Zambia; in 1969 the two sides also reached agreement on Soviet military bases after independence, and in 1974 Soviet aid was cut off completely during the Eastern Revolt before being resumed in November. Chinese supplies to UNITA from the mid-1970s likewise included Chinese-made AK derivatives. The Portuguese light weapons were of Western European pattern: G3 rifles and G3E light machine guns, FN MAG medium machine guns, two-inch and 81mm mortars and 105mm howitzers, with M41 tanks, Panhard light armoured vehicles and M113 infantry carriers in the inventory, and logistics carried on Land Rovers and three-ton lorries, with the sea lift handled by the transports Niassa and Benguela. The air force began the conflict with twenty-five F-84G jet fighter-bombers, six PV-2 Harpoon bombers, six Nord Noratlas transports, six Alouette II helicopters, eight T-6 light attack aircraft and eight Auster observation aircraft; by the early 1970s this had become four F-84G, six PV-2, thirteen Noratlas, C-47 and C-57 transports, thirty Alouette III and Puma helicopters, eighteen T-6 and twenty-six Dornier Do 27 observation aircraft, though against the size of Angolan ground the number of aircraft was never enough.
tactics: 游擊隊一方的基本單位是三至十五人的小組，配一支AK-47或舊式步槍與手槍，靠叢林、村落與水網游走，做法是設伏、破壞公路與橋樑、襲擊巡邏與補給縱隊，然後分散撤離，典型的打了就跑。城市攻擊只在開局出現：一九六一年二月四日MPLA同時在羅安達與本格拉動手，羅安達一線突襲聖保羅民事監獄、軍事偵察所與治安警察機動連營房，本格拉一線攻擊監獄與警察總部，目的是營救被捕的政治犯。葡軍的反游擊戰術逐步升級：一九六一年三月成立安哥拉義勇軍團，正式編組民間自衛，四月初在Uíge一帶的科盧阿村一役之後，軍方注意到游擊隊已敢攻擊正規軍，於是改以連級獵兵部隊為主力，配合火砲、工兵與空軍作三路合進的會戰式清剿；七月十日發動首次大規模行動Viriato行動，以獵兵營九十六營、一百一十四營與騎兵連一百四十九連三面夾擊南班萬貢一帶的登博斯林區。之後的行動模式是劃出淨化區、逐段推進，以直升機與F-84G對林區營地低空掃射，配合前沿基地的空投與空運維持。游擊隊這邊同樣在演變：一九六〇年代後期MPLA在東部建立解放區，以火箭筒與迫擊砲伏擊巡邏隊與車隊，FNLA則依靠剛果境內的營地作跨境襲擊的出發點。季候決定節奏，雨季泥濘使車隊難行，旱季河床可以通行，兩者都被游擊隊用來選擇伏擊點。
tacticsEn: The basic unit on the guerrilla side was a group of three to fifteen men carrying one AK-47 or an older rifle and a pistol, moving through forest, village and waterway, and their method was to lay ambushes, cut roads and bridges, strike patrols and supply columns and then disperse, the classic hit-and-run. Direct attacks on towns happened only at the opening: on 4 February 1961 the MPLA struck simultaneously in Luanda and in Benguela, the Luanda group assaulting the São Paulo civil jail, the military detection house and the barracks of the mobile police company, the Benguela group attacking the jail and the police headquarters, all of it aimed at freeing political prisoners. The Portuguese counter-insurgency escalated step by step: the Corps of Volunteers of Angola was established on 28 March 1961 to organise civilian volunteers, and after the action at the village of Cólua near Uíge in early April the army understood that the insurgents now dared to attack regular troops, so it shifted to caçadores companies as the main instrument, with artillery, engineers and air force supporting convergent attacks on three axes in the old style of set-piece sweeps. On 10 July the first large operation, Operation Viriato, was launched, with caçadores battalions 96 and 114 and cavalry squadron 149 closing on Nambuangongo in the Dembos forest from three directions. The pattern afterwards was to mark out cleared areas, advance section by section, sweep the forest camps with helicopters and F-84Gs at low level, and sustain the forward posts by air drop and air supply. The guerrillas evolved in turn: in the late 1960s the MPLA established liberated areas in the east and used recoilless launchers and mortars to ambush patrols and convoys, while the FNLA used camps inside the Congo as the launching points for attacks across the border. The seasons set the rhythm, with muddy tracks in the rains slowing convoys and dry river beds carrying them in the dry season, and the guerrillas used both to choose their ambush sites.
data: 可以引用的數字大致如下。安哥拉面積大於法國與德國之和，一九六〇年人口約五百萬，其中白人約十八萬、混血約五萬五千。保安部隊方面，公共治安警察約一萬名警員，PIDE約一千一百名探員（一九六〇年代中期）。空軍初期配二十五架F-84G、六架PV-2、六架Noratlas、六架Alouette II、八架T-6與八架Auster，至一九七〇年代初改為四架F-84G、六架PV-2、十三架Noratlas、C-47與C-57運輸機、三十架Alouette III與Puma、十八架T-6、二十六架Do 27。時間軸上，一九六一年二月二日槍戰造成十一人死亡，二月四日羅安達與本格拉同時起事，葡方公稱叛軍死亡不到三百，另有百餘名傷者在馬蘭熱醫院接受治療，安方保安部隊七人陣亡，其中五名白人警員、一名黑人警員與一名白人士兵；科盧阿村一役則是二十二名攻擊者死亡而保安部隊未有傷亡。三月二十一日首批本土主力獵兵營八十八營與九十二營乘Niassa號出發，五月二日抵達羅安達，運輸船Benguela號同運軍火，五月十三日主力開始向北部推進，戰事一直延續到一九七四年四月二十五日里斯本康乃馨革命。一九七五年一月五日三派在肯亞蒙巴沙會談，一月十五日在阿爾沃簽訂協議，規定十一月十一日獨立並設過渡政府；十月二十三日南非自納米比亞越境投入一千五百至兩千人。安哥拉方面，一九六一年全年全國死傷與外流人數以萬計，數十萬人湧向沙伊邊境與羅安達郊區；一九七五年三月十七日一千名FNLA戰士在金庫祖叛變，被扎伊爾軍方平下。卡面這支AK-47的諸元是：口徑七點六二乘三十九毫米，三十發弧形彈匣，木質槍托，全長約八百八十毫米，空槍重約四點三公斤，槍口初速每秒約七百一十五米，理論射速每分鐘約六百發，有效射程三百至四百米，一九四七年定型後遂成華約與各國游擊隊最常見的自動步槍。
dataEn: The figures that can be given on good authority are roughly these. Angola had a territory larger than France and Germany combined, and in 1960 a population of about five million, of which around one hundred and eighty thousand were white and fifty-five thousand mixed race. On the security side the Public Security Police numbered about ten thousand constables and the PIDE about eleven hundred agents in the mid-1960s. The air force began with twenty-five F-84G, six PV-2, six Noratlas, six Alouette II, eight T-6 and eight Auster, and by the early 1970s this stood at four F-84G, six PV-2, thirteen Noratlas, C-47 and C-57 transports, thirty Alouette III and Puma, eighteen T-6 and twenty-six Do 27. On the timeline: on 2 February 1961 a gun battle caused eleven deaths; on 4 February the rising began at once in Luanda and in Benguela, the Portuguese reporting fewer than three hundred rebels dead and more than a hundred wounded treated at the Malanje hospital, with seven of the Angolan security men killed, five white constables, one black constable and one white soldier; in the action at Cólua twenty-two attackers died with no losses among the security forces. On 21 March the first major contingent of the metropole, caçadores battalions 88 and 92, embarked on the Niassa and reached Luanda on 2 May, the transport Benguela sailing with war material, and on 13 May the main body began moving north; the war itself ran on until the Carnation Revolution in Lisbon on 25 April 1974. On 5 January 1975 the three movements met at Mombasa in Kenya, and on 15 January they signed the Alvor Agreement in Portugal, setting independence for 11 November and establishing a transitional government; on 23 October South Africa crossed from Namibia with between 1,500 and 2,000 men. On the Angolan side, the number of dead and displaced in the country as a whole ran into the tens of thousands during 1961, with several hundred thousand people pressing towards the Zaire frontier and the outskirts of Luanda; on 17 March 1975 a thousand FNLA fighters mutinied at Kinkuzu and the revolt was put down by the Zairian army. The figures of the AK-47 on the card are these: calibre 7.62x39mm, curved thirty-round magazine, wooden stock, length about eight hundred and eighty millimetres, weight about four point three kilograms empty, muzzle velocity about seven hundred and fifteen metres per second, theoretical rate of fire about six hundred rounds a minute, effective range three to four hundred metres; after its standardisation in 1947 it became the commonest automatic rifle of the Warsaw Pact and of guerrilla forces everywhere.
cause: 起事的原因是多層的。第一層是殖民經濟：安哥拉被劃入葡萄牙海外省體制之後，白人移民經營咖啡、劍麻、鑽石與鐵礦，港口與鐵路服務宗主國，而占人口多數的農村居民被強迫提供勞役，並被要求種植棉花等宗主國指定的經濟作物，強徵與稅役年年加壓，鄉村的怨氣在非洲其他殖民地起義的消息傳來之後迅速累積。第二層是組織與城市政治：安哥拉北部人民聯盟與MPLA分別在北部與城市知識分子中建立據點，羅伯托、da Cruz、Neto等人都有受過殖民教育的背景；一九六〇年十二月da Cruz與Pinto de Andrade在剛果被捕，一九六一年一月二十二日在聖多美島Baixa de Casanje監獄暴動中越獄並被轉移到羅安達，囚禁與營救把他們推到台前。第三層是外部環境：聯合國一九六〇年大會通過第1514號決議，承認殖民地人民有自決與獨立的權利，冷戰在非洲的介入又使三方各有外援，葡軍最初的應對——三月宣布戒嚴與軍事動員，四月十三日薩拉查以「迅速而有力地到安哥拉去」的講詞推動大批本土部隊開赴前線——反把原有的地方抗爭升級為全面戰爭。
causeEn: The outbreak had several layers of cause. The first was the colonial economy: once Angola had been folded into the Portuguese overseas province system, white settlers ran coffee, sisal, diamonds and iron ore while the ports and the railways served the metropole, and the rural majority of the population was compelled to provide labour and to plant crops such as cotton designated by the mother country, with the levies and the taxes growing year by year; rural resentment accumulated quickly once the news of risings in other African colonies began to arrive. The second layer was organisation and urban politics: the Union of the Peoples of Northern Angola and the MPLA built their bases in the north and among the urban intellectuals respectively, and men such as Roberto, da Cruz and Neto all had colonial schooling behind them; in December 1960 da Cruz and Pinto de Andrade were arrested in the Congo and escaped during the prison rising at Baixa de Casanje in São Tomé on 22 January 1961, and were transferred to Luanda, so that imprisonment and the attempt to rescue them pushed them to the fore. The third layer was the external environment: the United Nations General Assembly adopted Resolution 1514 in 1960 affirming the right of colonial peoples to self-determination and independence, and the Cold War presence in Africa gave each of the three movements an outside patron, while the Portuguese reaction of March, with martial law and military mobilisation, and of 13 April, with Salazar's broadcast promising to go to Angola rapidly and in force and the dispatch of large bodies of metropole troops, converted a local insurrection into a general war.
impact: 這場戰爭首先改變了葡萄牙。持續十四年的殖民地戰事把國家的財政、軍隊與海外政策全部捲入，安哥拉一役葡軍陣亡人數常被引述為八千八百五十人，另有統計連同失蹤與非戰傷者接近九千人，各來源略有出入；戰費與持續的海外動員最終壓垮了薩拉查的體制，一九七四年四月二十五日的康乃馨革命由反對海外戰爭的年輕軍官發動，獨裁統治在一天之內垮台，殖民政策改為立即撤出。國際層面上，安哥拉成為冷戰在非洲最重要的代理戰場：美國支援FNLA，蘇聯在六十年代末經坦尚尼亞與贊比亞向MPLA大量供應武器，中國自一九七〇年援助MPLA，南非在南部支援葡軍並於一九七五年直接出兵，同一塊土地上同時有四個大國的影子。聯合國裡的角力同樣明顯，一九七三年底大會通過決議，承認MPLA為安哥拉人民的唯一代表，這在非洲其他殖民地並未出現。獨立的代價則由安哥拉承擔：過渡政府迅速瓦解，衝突在一九七五年五月即全面復燃，古巴介入與南非越境把國家拖入長達二十餘年的內戰，直至一九九二年才停火。
impactEn: The war changed Portugal first. Fourteen years of colonial fighting drew the state's finances, its army and its overseas policy into the conflict, and the Portuguese military dead in Angola are commonly given as eight thousand eight hundred and fifty, with some counts that add the missing and the non-battle casualties bringing the figure close to nine thousand, the sources differing slightly; war costs and continuing mobilisation abroad finally broke the Salazar system, and the Carnation Revolution of 25 April 1974, launched by young officers tired of the overseas wars, brought down the dictatorship in a single day and replaced the colonial policy with immediate withdrawal. At the international level Angola became the most important proxy theatre of the Cold War in Africa: the United States backed the FNLA, the Soviet Union supplied the MPLA heavily through Tanzania and Zambia from the late 1960s, China began funding the MPLA in 1970, and South Africa supported the Portuguese in the south before entering the country directly in 1975, so that four great powers cast their shadows over the same patch of ground. The struggle at the United Nations was equally pointed, and at the end of 1973 the General Assembly adopted a resolution recognising the MPLA as the sole representative of the people of Angola, something that did not happen for the other African colonies. The cost of independence fell on Angola itself: the transitional government collapsed quickly, the fighting resumed across the country by May 1975, and the intervention of Cuban troops and the crossing of South African forces dragged the country into a civil war that ran for more than twenty years before the ceasefire of 1992.
result: 葡軍始終沒有平定安哥拉。一九七四年革命之後，新政府宣布停止在非洲的軍事行動並加快撤軍；一九七五年一月五日MPLA、FNLA與UNITA的代表在肯亞蒙巴沙會談，同意停止互相攻擊，同月十日至十五日在葡萄牙阿爾沃與葡方簽訂協議，規定十一月十一日獨立並成立過渡政府，FLEC與東方起義被排除在談判之外；葡軍在一九七五年一月底之前完成撤出，Neto於十一月十一日在羅安達宣布獨立，MPLA成為執政黨。但獨立並未帶來和平：三方在過渡政府中互相猜忌，五月起重新動武，羅安達街頭與北部山區再成戰場，卡賓達分離主義另立旗號，此後是安哥拉內戰而不是反殖民戰爭。就兵器而言，這一役把AK-47從蘇聯集團的制式步槍變成安哥拉的通用語言：游擊隊用它打穿了十四年的殖民戰爭，MPLA部隊在獨立之後沿用同一批槍械與同一套游擊戰術，蘇聯、古巴與南非的介入部隊也在同一片國土上用同一型步槍交手，這條線一直延續到一九九〇年代內戰結束。
resultEn: The Portuguese never pacified Angola. After the revolution of 1974 the new government declared an end to military action in Africa and hurried the withdrawal; on 5 January 1975 the representatives of the MPLA, the FNLA and UNITA met at Mombasa in Kenya and agreed to stop attacking each other, and between 10 and 15 January they signed the Alvor Agreement with the Portuguese, fixing independence for 11 November and establishing a transitional government, with FLEC and the Eastern Revolt excluded from the talks; the Portuguese forces completed their withdrawal before the end of January 1975, and on 11 November Neto proclaimed independence in Luanda, with the MPLA becoming the governing party. But independence brought no peace: the three movements distrusted each other inside the transitional government, fighting restarted in May, and the streets of Luanda and the hills of the north became a battlefield once more, while the Cabinda separatists raised their own flag, and what followed was the Angolan civil war rather than a war of decolonisation. As for the weapon, this campaign turned the AK-47 from the standard rifle of the Soviet bloc into a common language in Angola: the guerrillas used it to fight through fourteen years of colonial war, the MPLA carried the same weapons and the same guerrilla doctrine into independence, and the intervening forces of the Soviet Union, of Cuba and of South Africa met one another on the same soil with the same type of rifle, a line that ran on until the end of the civil war in the 1990s.
